episodes.title: What Is a Cult? How to Recognise One, and Why They're Not Just Religious
episodes.description:
There are an estimated 2000 cults quietly operating across the UK right now. Not hooded figures in isolated camps, but WhatsApp groups, wellness communities, fitness collectives, and offices two streets from where you live.

In this video I break down what a cult actually is, the warning signs that tend to show up long before anyone realises what they're inside, and why the biggest myth about cults is that they're a religious problem. They're not. Political movements, self help seminars, multi level marketing schemes, and personality driven online communities can all run on exactly the same mechanics, love bombing, information control, escalating commitment, and no graceful way out.
